cogent.zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的
ai: She made a cogent argument for starting the project earlier.
她提出了有說服力的論點，主張提早開始這個專案。
The lawyer gave a cogent explanation that the whole jury understood.
律師的解釋十分中肯，全體陪審員都聽懂了。
I found his reasons cogent, so I changed my mind.
我覺得他的理由很有說服力，所以改變了想法。
Ecotourism brings money to the village without harming the forest.
生態旅遊為村莊帶來收入，又不會破壞森林。
We chose ecotourism for our trip and stayed in a small eco-lodge.
我們這趟旅行選擇生態旅遊，住在小型生態旅舍。

alarmist.zh: 杞人憂天的人；危言聳聽者
ai: Don't be such an alarmist; it's only a small cold.
別那麼杞人憂天，只是小感冒而已。
The scientist was called an alarmist, but his warning turned out to be right.
那位科學家被說成危言聳聽，但他的警告後來證明是對的。

dissolved.zh: 溶解（dissolve 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The sugar dissolved quickly in the hot tea.
糖很快就在熱茶裡溶解了。
She dissolved two tablets in a glass of water.
她把兩顆藥錠溶在一杯水裡。
The president dissolved the parliament and called a new election.
總統解散了國會並宣布重新選舉。
The band dissolved after their last tour.
那個樂團在最後一次巡演後解散了。
Fish need dissolved oxygen to live in the water.
魚需要水中的溶解氧才能生存。
The test measures the amount of dissolved salt in the sample.
這項檢測測量樣本中溶解鹽的含量。
The boa wrapped itself around a branch and waited.
那條蟒蛇纏在樹枝上靜靜等待。
A boa is not poisonous, but it can squeeze its prey.
蟒蛇沒有毒，但會絞緊獵物。
She wore a pink feather boa to the costume party.
她戴著粉紅色羽毛圍巾去參加變裝派對。
The singer tossed her boa into the cheering crowd.
歌手把她的羽毛圍巾拋向歡呼的人群。

yielding.zh: 柔順的；易屈服的；柔軟的
ai: The yielding mattress felt soft and comfortable.
那張柔軟的床墊躺起來很舒服。
He was a gentle, yielding man who rarely argued.
他是個溫和順從的人，很少與人爭論。

yielding.zh: 屈服；讓步；產出（yield 的現在分詞）
ai: The company is yielding to pressure from its customers.
公司正向顧客的壓力讓步。
The new method is yielding better results every year.
這個新方法每年都產出更好的成果。

untried.zh: 未經試驗的；沒有經驗的
ai: The plan is bold but still untried.
這個計畫很大膽，但還沒有經過試驗。
They hired an untried manager for the new shop.
他們為新店雇了一位沒有經驗的經理。
I don't want to leave any option untried.
我不想放過任何一個還沒試過的辦法。
The waiter unobtrusively refilled our glasses.
服務生不著痕跡地替我們把杯子斟滿。
She slipped unobtrusively into the back row of the hall.
她悄悄地溜進禮堂最後一排坐下。
She is grateful for her family's unfailing support.
她很感謝家人始終如一的支持。
He greeted everyone with unfailing good humor.
他總是帶著不變的幽默感跟大家打招呼。
Glaucoma can damage your sight if it isn't treated early.
青光眼若沒有及早治療，可能損害視力。
My grandfather uses eye drops every day to control his glaucoma.
我爺爺每天點眼藥水來控制青光眼。
He studiously avoided talking about money during dinner.
晚餐時他刻意避開談錢的話題。
She studiously copied every word from the board.
她認真地把黑板上每個字都抄下來。
The bike has a small stabilizer to keep the child from falling.
這輛腳踏車有個小輔助輪，免得孩子跌倒。
A stabilizer on the camera keeps the video from shaking.
相機上的穩定器能避免影片晃動。
The job was really just a glorified secretary position.
這份工作其實只是個名義好聽的祕書職位。
His glorified version of the story left out the hard parts.
他把故事美化了，略過了艱難的部分。
She painted the door a bright chartreuse.
她把門漆成鮮豔的黃綠色。
Chartreuse is a color between yellow and green.
黃綠色是介於黃色與綠色之間的顏色。
Sorry, I think I overstepped by reading your messages.
抱歉，我想我看了你的訊息是越界了。
Managers must not overstep the limits of their authority.
主管不得逾越自己的職權範圍。
The referee warned him not to overstep the line again.
裁判警告他別再踩過那條線。
The villain's henchman followed the hero through the market.
反派的爪牙跟著英雄穿過市集。
He was the mayor's loyal henchman for twenty years.
他當了市長二十年的忠實親信。
Your call came at an opportune moment.
你的電話打來得正是時候。
She waited for an opportune time to ask for a raise.
她等待一個合適的時機要求加薪。
The bright sign looked obtrusive against the old stone wall.
那面亮眼的招牌在古老石牆上顯得突兀。
A good waiter is attentive but never obtrusive.
好的服務生會周到但不令人覺得打擾。
The new office tower is a monstrosity that ruins the view.
這棟新辦公大樓醜得像怪物，破壞了景觀。
She hated the monstrosity of a sofa her aunt gave her.
她很討厭阿姨送她的那張醜得誇張的沙發。
She brushed her long, lustrous hair every night.
她每晚梳理那頭亮澤的長髮。
The pearls were smooth and lustrous.
那些珍珠光滑又有光澤。
Remember to lubricate the chain before you ride.
騎車前記得替鏈條上油。
Oil is used to lubricate the engine's moving parts.
機油用來潤滑引擎的運轉零件。
We rented a rowboat and paddled across the lake.
我們租了一艘划艇划過湖面。
The old man kept a small rowboat tied to the dock.
老先生在碼頭邊繫著一艘小划艇。
The state of the old library is lamentable.
那間老圖書館的狀況令人惋惜。
It is lamentable that so many people never vote.
這麼多人從不投票，實在可嘆。
The spacecraft fired its thruster to change direction.
太空船啟動推進器改變方向。
Each small boat has a thruster at the front to help it dock.
每艘小船前方都有推進器幫助靠岸。
There was an odd incongruity between his words and his smile.
他的話語和笑容之間有種奇怪的不協調。
The incongruity of a pink car in the old village made us laugh.
古老村莊裡出現一輛粉紅色汽車，這種格格不入讓我們笑了。
In the story, the fiend haunted the castle at night.
故事裡，那個惡魔夜夜在城堡裡作祟。
The villagers called him a fiend after what he did.
他做了那些事之後，村民稱他為惡魔。
My brother is a real coffee fiend.
我弟弟是個十足的咖啡迷。
She's a fitness fiend who runs every morning.
她是運動狂，每天早上都跑步。

unsung.zh: 默默無聞的；未受表揚的
ai: Nurses are often the unsung heroes of a hospital.
護理師常是醫院裡默默付出的英雄。
The unsung writer finally received an award.
那位默默無聞的作家終於得獎了。
The cat hid in the shrubbery beside the house.
貓躲在房子旁的灌木叢裡。
We trimmed the shrubbery along the garden path.
我們修剪了花園小徑旁的灌木叢。
Her performance was faultless from start to finish.
她的演出從頭到尾完美無缺。
He speaks faultless English after years abroad.
在國外住了多年，他的英文說得無可挑剔。
The team played excellently in the final match.
球隊在決賽中表現極為出色。
The old machine still works excellently.
那台老機器仍然運作得非常好。

unmoving.zh: 一動也不動的；不為所動的
ai: The deer stood unmoving at the edge of the road.
那隻鹿一動也不動地站在路邊。
She stared at the unmoving clock on the wall.
她盯著牆上停住不動的時鐘。
The air is drier in winter than in summer.
冬天的空氣比夏天乾燥。
Use a drier cloth to wipe the table.
用比較乾的布擦桌子。
I put the wet towels in the drier.
我把濕毛巾放進烘乾機。
She used a hair drier before leaving for work.
她出門上班前用吹風機吹頭髮。
Cheating on the exam is punishable by suspension.
考試作弊可處以停學。
Speeding is a punishable offense in most countries.
超速在多數國家都是應受處罰的行為。
I prefer a quiet dinner to the glitz of a big party.
比起盛大派對的浮華，我更喜歡安靜的晚餐。
The show was full of glitz, but the story was weak.
這場秀充滿炫目的華麗，故事卻很薄弱。
There was dissension among the team members about the plan.
團隊成員對這個計畫意見不一。
The new rule caused dissension in the family.
這項新規定在家裡引起了紛爭。

truism.zh: 老生常談；不言而喻的道理
ai: It's a truism that practice makes perfect.
熟能生巧是老生常談了。
He ended the speech with a tired truism about hard work.
他以一句陳腔濫調的努力論結束了演講。
Our opinions on this are diametrically opposed.
我們對這件事的看法截然相反。
Her style is diametrically different from her sister's.
她的風格和她姊姊完全不同。
I have a zillion things to do before the trip.
出發旅行前我有一大堆事要做。
There were zillions of stars in the desert sky.
沙漠的夜空裡有數不清的星星。
He sank into despondency after losing his job.
他失業後陷入沮喪。
A feeling of despondency filled the room after the defeat.
敗北之後，一股低落的氣氛籠罩著房間。
He looked haggard after three sleepless nights.
連續三個晚上沒睡後，他看起來憔悴不堪。
The haggard travelers finally reached the village.
那些憔悴的旅人終於抵達了村莊。
The overcooked vegetables turned into mush.
煮過頭的蔬菜變成了一團爛糊。
The baby ate a bowl of rice mush for lunch.
寶寶午餐吃了一碗米糊。
The shop sells chocolates and other confectionery.
這家店賣巧克力和其他糖果點心。
She works in a confectionery factory near the station.
她在車站附近的糖果工廠工作。
The city is known for its petrochemical industry.
這座城市以石化工業聞名。
A petrochemical plant was built near the coast.
海岸附近蓋了一座石化廠。

chauvinist.zh: 沙文主義者；大男人主義者
ai: He was a chauvinist who thought women shouldn't work.
他是個大男人主義者，認為女人不該工作。
Nobody wants to work for a chauvinist boss.
沒有人想替大男人主義的老闆工作。
It takes willpower to get up early every day.
每天早起需要意志力。
She quit smoking through sheer willpower.
她全憑意志力戒了菸。
The investigation showed the driver was blameless.
調查顯示那位駕駛毫無過失。
She led a quiet, blameless life.
她過著平靜而無可挑剔的生活。
Some snakes in this forest are venomous.
這座森林裡有些蛇是有毒的。
A venomous spider bit him on the hand.
一隻毒蜘蛛咬了他的手。
The meeting ended in acrimony.
會議在互相指責中收場。
They divorced without any acrimony.
他們離婚時沒有任何怨恨。
I like flavored tea, especially peach.
我喜歡調味茶，尤其是水蜜桃口味。
The store sells many kinds of flavored water.
這家店賣許多種口味的調味水。

watching.zh: 觀看；注視（watch 的現在分詞）
ai: I was watching a movie when you called.
你打電話來時我正在看電影。
The children are watching the birds in the yard.
孩子們正在看院子裡的鳥。
The urbane host welcomed every guest warmly.
那位文雅的主人熱情地歡迎每一位賓客。
He is an urbane man with excellent manners.
他是個舉止極佳、談吐文雅的人。

carpeted.zh: 鋪地毯（carpet 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: They carpeted the whole house before moving in.
他們搬進去之前把整間房子都鋪上了地毯。
The stairs were carpeted in dark red.
樓梯鋪著深紅色的地毯。
The boxer gave his opponent a thrashing.
那位拳擊手把對手打得慘敗。
Our team took a thrashing in last night's game.
我們隊在昨晚比賽中慘遭痛擊。
His coat hung in tatters after the long journey.
長途旅行後，他的外套破爛不堪。
The flag was torn to tatters by the storm.
那面旗被暴風雨撕成了碎布條。
My old laptop is heavy and clunky.
我的舊筆電又重又笨。
The app's design feels clunky and hard to use.
這個應用程式的設計很笨拙，不好用。

drugged.zh: 下藥；使服麻醉藥（drug 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The thief drugged the guard's coffee.
小偷在警衛的咖啡裡下了藥。
In the movie, the hero is drugged and wakes up in a strange room.
電影裡，主角被下藥，醒來時人在陌生的房間。

inalienable.zh: 不可剝奪的；不可轉讓的
ai: Freedom of speech is an inalienable right.
言論自由是不可剝奪的權利。
The document lists the inalienable rights of every citizen.
這份文件列出每位公民不可剝奪的權利。
A burr got stuck on my sock during the walk.
散步時有一顆帶刺的種子黏在我的襪子上。
He filed off the burr left on the metal edge.
他把金屬邊緣留下的毛邊磨掉。
He sat in a drunken stupor on the sofa.
他醉得昏昏沉沉地坐在沙發上。
The news shook her out of her stupor.
這則消息把她從恍惚中驚醒。
The lighthouse stands on a rocky promontory.
燈塔矗立在多岩石的海岬上。
From the promontory we could see the whole bay.
從岬角上我們可以看見整個海灣。

shortened.zh: 縮短（shorten 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The tailor shortened the pants by two inches.
裁縫把褲子改短了兩吋。
Heavy traffic shortened our time at the museum.
嚴重的塞車縮短了我們在博物館的時間。
The prodigal heir spent his fortune in a year.
那位揮霍無度的繼承人一年就花光了財產。
She regretted her prodigal habits after losing her savings.
失去存款後，她後悔自己的揮霍習慣。
One company tried to monopolise the whole market.
有一家公司試圖壟斷整個市場。
Please don't monopolise the conversation; let others speak.
請不要獨佔談話，讓別人也說話。

unspoiled.zh: 未受破壞的；保持原貌的
ai: The island still has unspoiled beaches.
這座島上仍有未受破壞的海灘。
We hiked through unspoiled forest for two days.
我們在未遭破壞的森林裡健行了兩天。
I don't like fizzy drinks; I prefer flat water.
我不喜歡有氣泡的飲料，比較喜歡不含氣的水。
The fizzy soda tickled my nose.
那杯氣泡汽水讓我的鼻子癢癢的。
Scientists are planning an interplanetary mission to Mars.
科學家正在規劃前往火星的行星際任務。
Interplanetary travel would take many months.
行星際旅行得花上好幾個月。
The water gurgled down the drain.
水汩汩地流進排水孔。
The baby gurgled happily in her crib.
寶寶在嬰兒床裡開心地咕咕作聲。
She washed the crockery after dinner.
她晚餐後洗了碗盤。
The shop sells cheap kitchen crockery.
這家店賣便宜的廚房陶瓷餐具。

marinated.zh: 醃泡（marinate 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: I marinated the chicken in soy sauce overnight.
我把雞肉用醬油醃了一整晚。
The marinated fish tasted rich and a little sweet.
醃過的魚吃起來味道濃郁又帶點甜。
Copper sulfate forms bright blue crystals.
硫酸銅會形成亮藍色的結晶。
Some shampoos say they contain no sulfate.
有些洗髮精標示不含硫酸鹽。
Please annotate the text with your own notes.
請在文章上寫下你自己的註解。
The teacher asked us to annotate each poem we read.
老師要求我們為讀過的每首詩加上註解。
She accepted the invitation with alacrity.
她欣然接受了邀請。
The staff moved with alacrity to fix the problem.
員工迅速動手解決問題。
The doctors treated several malnourished children.
醫生們治療了幾位營養不良的孩子。
A diet of only bread left him malnourished.
只吃麵包的飲食使他營養不良。
A strange sense of unreality came over her after the news.
聽到那個消息後，她心頭湧上一股奇異的不真實感。
The fog gave the street an air of unreality.
霧讓這條街道帶著一種虛幻的氣氛。
You can see the vein pulsate in his neck.
你可以看到他脖子上的血管在搏動。
The lights pulsate in time with the music.
燈光隨著音樂的節奏閃動。
The old bridge has fallen into disrepair.
那座老橋已經年久失修。
The house was in such disrepair that nobody wanted to buy it.
那棟房子破敗不堪，沒有人想買。

unguarded.zh: 無人看守的；毫無防備的
ai: The back door was left unguarded all night.
後門整晚沒人看守。
In an unguarded moment, he told her the secret.
他在一時不經意間把祕密告訴了她。
The course covers Aristotelian ideas about ethics.
這門課探討亞里斯多德的倫理學觀點。
Aristotelian logic influenced thinkers for centuries.
亞里斯多德的邏輯影響了思想家好幾個世紀。
She is studying dermatology to become a skin doctor.
她正在學皮膚科學，想成為皮膚科醫師。
The hospital has a new dermatology department.
醫院新設了皮膚科。

unacknowledged.zh: 未被承認的；未被認可的
ai: His hard work went unacknowledged by the boss.
他的努力沒有得到老闆的認可。
The email remained unacknowledged for a week.
那封電子郵件一週都沒有人回覆。
The puppy was born hairless and pink.
小狗出生時身上沒毛，粉粉的。
He shaved his head and now looks completely hairless.
他把頭剃光了，現在看起來完全沒頭髮。
She shrewdly waited until prices dropped before buying.
她精明地等到價格下跌才買。
He shrewdly guessed what the customer really wanted.
他機靈地猜出了客人真正想要什麼。
After some reconsideration, I decided to accept the offer.
重新考慮之後，我決定接受這份工作。
The committee agreed to a reconsideration of the rule.
委員會同意重新審議這項規定。
Stress raises the level of cortisol in the body.
壓力會提高體內的皮質醇濃度。
Good sleep helps keep cortisol under control.
良好的睡眠有助於控制皮質醇。
I like to snack on salted cashews.
我喜歡吃鹽味腰果當零食。
The curry is creamy because it uses ground cashew.
這道咖哩因為加了腰果泥而口感綿密。
The ophthalmologist checked my eyes and gave me new glasses.
眼科醫師檢查了我的眼睛，開了新眼鏡給我。
You should see an ophthalmologist if your vision suddenly blurs.
如果視力突然模糊，你應該去看眼科醫師。
The results of the test are problematical.
這項測試的結果有問題。
It's problematical whether the road will open before winter.
這條路能否在冬天前通車還是個問題。

prefect.zh: 學長（負責維持秩序的學生幹部）
ai: The prefect told the students to line up quietly.
那位級長叫學生們安靜排隊。
She was chosen as a prefect in her final year.
她在最後一年被選為級長。
She wrapped the cheese in a piece of muslin.
她用一塊平紋細布把起司包起來。
The curtains were made of thin white muslin.
那些窗簾是薄薄的白色細棉布做的。
I don't care a whit what they think.
我一點也不在乎他們怎麼想。
He is not one whit better than before.
他一點也沒有比以前更好。
The police arrested the kingpin of the smuggling ring.
警方逮捕了走私集團的首腦。
She is the kingpin of our department; nothing happens without her.
她是我們部門的關鍵人物，沒有她什麼事都做不成。
The artist mixed umber into the paint to make it darker.
畫家把棕土色顏料混進去讓顏色變深。
The autumn leaves turned a warm umber.
秋天的樹葉變成了溫暖的赭褐色。
His mercurial temper made him hard to work with.
他善變的脾氣讓人很難與他共事。
The coach is brilliant but mercurial.
那位教練很出色，但情緒起伏不定。
Experts were asked to authenticate the old painting.
專家受託鑑定那幅古畫。
You must authenticate your identity before you can log in.
登入之前你必須先驗證身分。

irresistibly.zh: 不可抗拒地；極具誘惑地
ai: The smell of fresh bread drew us irresistibly into the bakery.
新鮮麵包的香味令人無法抗拒地把我們吸進了麵包店。
The baby is irresistibly cute when she laughs.
寶寶笑起來可愛得讓人無法抗拒。
The stitching on this bag is very neat.
這個包包的縫線非常整齊。
The coat came apart because the stitching was weak.
因為縫線不牢，那件外套裂開了。
Fourthly, we need to think about the cost.
第四，我們得考慮成本。
First we plan, second we build, third we test, and fourthly we launch.
首先規劃，其次建造，第三測試，第四上線。
The ghost was just a figment of his imagination.
那個鬼只是他想像出來的東西。
Her fears were a figment of a tired mind.
她的恐懼不過是疲憊心靈的虛構。
She spoke to a roomful of students.
她對著滿屋子的學生演講。
A roomful of guests sang happy birthday.
滿屋子的賓客一起唱生日快樂歌。
Leaving the stove on was pure irresponsibility.
把爐火開著不管，簡直是不負責任。
His irresponsibility cost the team the whole project.
他的不負責任讓整個團隊丟了這個專案。
The company wants to centralise all its customer service in one office.
公司想把所有客服集中在一個辦公室。
The government plans to centralise control of the schools.
政府打算把學校的管理權集中起來。
His face turned ashen when he heard the news.
聽到消息時，他的臉色變得慘白。
The sky was ashen after the fire.
大火過後，天空一片灰濛。
The park becomes a winter wonderland after the first snow.
第一場雪後，公園變成了冬季仙境。
The kids saw the toy store as a wonderland.
孩子們把那家玩具店當成奇幻樂園。
Push-ups work your chest and your triceps.
伏地挺身能訓練胸肌和三頭肌。
He strained his triceps while lifting weights.
他舉重時拉傷了三頭肌。
The movie was a big letdown after all the hype.
經過那麼多宣傳，這部電影讓人大失所望。
Losing the game was a letdown for the whole town.
輸掉比賽讓全鎮的人都很失望。

mitigating.zh: 減輕；緩和（mitigate 的現在分詞）
ai: The city is mitigating flood risk by building new drains.
市政府正以興建新排水系統來減輕水災風險。
Planting trees is one way of mitigating the heat in summer.
種樹是緩解夏季酷熱的方法之一。
The kids made such a ruckus that the neighbors complained.
孩子們吵得鄰居都來抱怨。
A ruckus broke out when the referee ignored the foul.
裁判無視犯規，引發了一陣騷動。
The puppy's playfulness made everyone smile.
小狗的調皮可愛讓大家都笑了。
Her playfulness brightened up the long meeting.
她的俏皮讓冗長的會議活潑了起來。
The museum teaches visitors about the genocidal regime of the past.
博物館向參觀者介紹過去那個進行種族滅絕的政權。
The world must never forget genocidal violence.
世界絕不能忘記種族滅絕的暴行。
The radio's selectivity lets it pick up one station without noise.
這台收音機的選擇性使它能不受雜訊干擾地收單一電台。
The university is known for its high selectivity in admissions.
這所大學以招生篩選嚴格著稱。
We collected shells along the seashore.
我們沿著海邊撿貝殼。
Their house stands right on the seashore.
他們的房子就蓋在海濱邊。
Every doubter was surprised when the plan worked.
當計畫成功時，每個持懷疑態度的人都很驚訝。
She proved the doubters wrong by finishing the race.
她完成了比賽，證明那些懷疑者錯了。
She wrote a short thank-you on blue notepaper.
她在藍色信紙上寫了一張簡短的感謝信。
I keep a pad of notepaper next to the phone.
我在電話旁放了一本便條紙。
Too many changes will disorganize the whole schedule.
太多變動會打亂整個時間表。
Moving to a new office tends to disorganize the team for a while.
搬到新辦公室往往會讓團隊亂一陣子。
This book is a modern retelling of an old fairy tale.
這本書是一則古老童話的現代改寫版。
His retelling of the trip made everyone laugh.
他重述這趟旅行的經過，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
The doctor felt for a pulse in his carotid.
醫生摸他的頸動脈來測脈搏。
The carotid carries blood from the heart to the head.
頸動脈把血液從心臟送往頭部。
The gamekeeper walked the estate every morning.
獵場看守人每天早上巡視莊園。
A gamekeeper protects the birds and animals on the land.
獵場看守人負責保護土地上的鳥類與動物。
The barn was afire when the firefighters arrived.
消防員抵達時穀倉正燃燒著。
Her cheeks were afire with embarrassment.
她羞得雙頰發燙。
The old house is cold and draughty in winter.
那棟老房子冬天又冷又漏風。
We moved to a seat away from the draughty window.
我們換到離漏風窗戶遠一點的座位。

decided.zh: 決定（decide 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: We decided to take the earlier train.
我們決定搭早一點的火車。
She has decided not to move abroad.
她已決定不搬到國外了。
The new plan is a decided improvement.
新計畫明顯是一項改進。
He spoke in a decided tone and nobody argued.
他用堅決的語氣說話，沒有人反駁。
They visited a Benedictine monastery in the mountains.
他們參觀了山上的本篤會修道院。
The Benedictine monks make their own bread.
本篤會的修士自己做麵包。
Helping a neighbor in need is considered a mitzvah.
幫助有需要的鄰居被視為一件善行。
Visiting the sick is a mitzvah in Jewish tradition.
探望病人在猶太傳統裡是一項善行。
The arroyo was dry for most of the year.
那條旱溪一年中大部分時間都是乾的。
After the storm, water rushed down the arroyo.
暴風雨過後，水沿著乾谷奔流而下。
The book describes Israelite customs from ancient times.
這本書描述了古代以色列人的習俗。
An Israelite village once stood on this hill.
這座山丘上曾有一個以色列人的村落。
Look at yon hill, where the sun is setting.
看那邊的山丘，太陽正在那裡落下。
The old song speaks of yon river and the green valley.
那首老歌唱到遠處的河流和綠色山谷。
The sorrowful music made her cry.
那悲傷的音樂讓她哭了。
He gave a sorrowful smile and said goodbye.
他帶著哀傷的微笑說了再見。
The reappearance of the sun made everyone cheerful.
太陽再度露臉讓大家都開心起來。
Fans celebrated the singer's reappearance after a long break.
歌手在長期休息後重新現身，歌迷歡欣慶祝。
A clarion call for change was heard across the country.
全國都聽到了要求改變的響亮呼聲。
Her clarion voice carried across the field.
她清亮的嗓音傳遍了整片場地。

joel.zh: 約珥（《聖經》中的先知；《約珥書》）
ai: Joel is one of the prophets in the Hebrew Bible.
約珥是希伯來聖經中的先知之一。
The Book of Joel is a short book in the Old Testament.
《約珥書》是舊約聖經裡篇幅較短的一卷。

donated.zh: 捐贈（donate 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She donated her old books to the local library.
她把舊書捐給了當地圖書館。
Many people donated blood after the accident.
意外發生後，許多人捐了血。
Try not to antagonise your neighbors over a small problem.
別為了小問題惹惱你的鄰居。
His rude comments antagonised the whole committee.
他無禮的言論讓整個委員會都很反感。
They smoked the meat over hickory for hours.
他們用山核桃木煙燻那塊肉好幾個小時。
The handle of the axe was made of hickory.
斧頭的柄是山核桃木做的。
The village has a traditional bathhouse near the river.
村裡河邊有一間傳統的澡堂。
We changed our clothes in the bathhouse by the beach.
我們在海灘邊的更衣浴室換了衣服。
It's an undemanding job with plenty of free time.
這是份要求不高又有很多空閒時間的工作。
She is a calm, undemanding guest who needs very little.
她是個隨和不挑剔的客人，幾乎沒什麼需求。
He bought a new tennis racquet for the tournament.
他為了比賽買了一支新網球拍。
She swung her racquet and hit the ball hard.
她揮動球拍用力擊球。
The sportscaster described the final minutes of the game.
體育播報員描述了比賽最後幾分鐘的情況。
My uncle works as a radio sportscaster.
我叔叔是廣播電台的體育播報員。
We played pinball at the arcade all afternoon.
我們整個下午都在遊樂場玩彈珠台。
The pinball machine flashed and rang when he scored.
他得分時，彈珠台閃著燈並響起鈴聲。
Earthbound astronomers rely on telescopes to see the stars.
待在地面上的天文學家得靠望遠鏡觀星。
After the storm, all earthbound flights were cancelled.
暴風雨之後，所有班機都停飛了。
The earthquake began to convulse the whole region.
地震開始讓整個地區劇烈震動。
The joke made the audience convulse with laughter.
那個笑話讓觀眾笑得前仰後合。
Paint chipping off the wall showed the house needed repair.
牆上剝落的油漆碎片顯示房子需要整修。
The workers swept up the stone chipping from the floor.
工人把地上的石屑掃乾淨。
The building has great esthetic appeal.
這棟建築有很高的美感。
She chose the color for esthetic reasons, not practical ones.
她出於美感而非實用的考量選了這個顏色。
I love the wildness of the mountains.
我喜愛山林的野性之美。
The wildness of the coast attracts many hikers.
海岸荒野的氣息吸引了許多登山客。
Our team clobbered the visitors 8 to 1.
我們隊以八比一痛宰了客隊。
If you touch my sandwich again, I'll clobber you.
你要是再碰我的三明治，我就扁你。
We had lunch at a cafe by the waterside.
我們在水邊的咖啡館吃了午餐。
Children played along the waterside until sunset.
孩子們在水邊玩到日落。
The land was given to the town in perpetuity.
這塊土地被永久贈與給小鎮。
He wanted his name to be remembered in perpetuity.
他希望自己的名字永遠被人記住。
The cornea is the clear front part of the eye.
角膜是眼睛前方透明的部分。
He had surgery to repair a scratch on his cornea.
他動手術修復角膜上的刮傷。
She told her confessor about her worries.
她把自己的煩惱告訴了聽她告解的神父。
The priest served as a confessor to many families in the town.
這位神父是鎮上許多家庭的告解神父。
In the movie, the crew travels through a wormhole to another galaxy.
電影裡，太空人穿過蟲洞前往另一個星系。
Physicists study the wormhole as a possible shortcut through space.
物理學家把蟲洞當成穿越太空的可能捷徑來研究。

michelangelo.zh: 米開朗基羅（義大利文藝復興藝術家）
ai: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel in Rome.
米開朗基羅在羅馬西斯汀禮拜堂繪製了天花板畫。
Michelangelo also carved the famous statue of David.
米開朗基羅也雕刻了著名的大衛像。
The artist began with a thin brown underpainting.
畫家先以一層薄薄的棕色打底。
You can sometimes see the underpainting through the top layers of color.
有時你能透過上層顏料看見底層的畫底。

sorting.zh: 分類；整理（sort 的現在分詞）
ai: I'm sorting my clothes into two piles.
我正把衣服分成兩堆。
She spent the afternoon sorting old photos.
她花了一個下午整理舊照片。
Stratospheric winds can reach very high speeds.
同溫層的風速可以非常快。
The balloon rose to a stratospheric height.
氣球升到了同溫層的高度。
As a southerner, he is used to warm winters.
身為南方人，他習慣了溫暖的冬天。
The northern visitors were surprised by the southerner's slow, friendly way of talking.
北方來的訪客對那位南方人慢悠悠又親切的說話方式感到驚訝。
Her quick riposte made the audience laugh.
她機敏的回嘴逗得觀眾大笑。
He had a sharp riposte for every question.
每個問題他都有犀利的回應。
